results.title: Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and Grenadines meets Minister of State at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
results.description:
Kingstown: Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines HE Godwin Friday met in Kingstown on Tuesday with Minister of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs HE Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulaziz bin Saleh Al Khulaifi.

During the meeting, both sides discussed cooperation between the two countries and ways to deepen and expand it, as well as the latest developments in Latin America and several issues of common interest.

HE the Minister of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stressed the importance of strengthening shared international efforts to help consolidate security and stability in Latin America.
HE Director General of the Qatar Fund for Development Fahad bin Hamad Al Sulaiti attended the meeting.
